integrity: All-size claims proved symbolically; exact rational finite checks provide corroboration rather than a proof of infinitude. No independent external validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to loopless cliques, synchronous all-neighbor updates, and mutually independent fair tie coins; excludes other topology/tie mechanisms. The K_3=C_3 special case is prior covered; unindexed priority risk remains.
title: Sharp one-vote reversal and bounded stabilization for random majority on complete graphs
